verdict: Thosai kosong wins for weight loss. It has almost half the calories of roti canai and much less fat.
why: Thosai kosong is only about 170 kcal, roti canai kosong about 300 kcal. A difference of roughly 130 kcal per piece.
Thosai has about 4 g of fat versus 12 g for roti canai, because roti canai is kneaded and cooked with oil or margarine.
Protein isn't very different: about 5 g for thosai, 7 g for roti canai. Both are low in protein, so pair them smartly.
Because thosai is lighter, you can eat two pieces and still have fewer calories than two pieces of roti canai.
when_a: Roti canai is okay when you have a craving and one piece is enough, and the rest of your day is fairly light.
when_b: Thosai suits a daily breakfast at the mamak when you want to feel full with fewer calories.
tip: Eat thosai with dhal gravy and add a boiled or half-boiled egg. You get more protein and it lasts you longer until lunch.

faq.q: Is thosai kosong alone enough for breakfast?
faq.a: One thosai is quite light. If you get hungry fast, take two pieces or add an egg so you have some protein.

faq.q: If I really love roti canai, do I have to stop eating it?
faq.a: No need. Eat one piece, enjoy it, and don't make it an everyday thing. On other days you can switch to thosai or chapati.
